name: textprov
description: Records prompt, Write/Edit and final-answer observations in the shared TextProv attribution chronicle and exposes /textprov for inspection, matching and explicit claims.

textprov_python.title: TextProv checkout (python/ directory)
textprov_python.description: Directory that contains the textprov package with chronicle.py, such as /path/to/textprov/python. Leave empty to use an installed textprov package.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Command used to run the chronicle bridge (Python 3.9 or newer).

data_dir.title: Chronicle data directory
data_dir.description: Where per-project chronicle databases are kept. Leave empty for ~/.claude/plugins/data/textprov.
